Description: The system shall prevent omitting required avoidance maneuvers.
[Reference to SR-1.1 including sub-requirements]
[Reference to SR-1.2 including sub-requirements]
The system shall identify controller failures.
The system shall mitigate controller failures.
The system shall detect when the steering commands are not on time (tbd).
The system shall detect when the steering commands are out of reasonable bounds (tbd).
The system shall identify failures of the steering actuators.
The system shall identify when the steering actuators do not engage.
The system shall identify when the steering actuators over- or undershoot the steering commands.
The system shall mitigate failures of the steering actuators.
The system shall identify failures of the brake actuators.
The system shall identify when the brake actuators do not engage.
The system shall mitigate failures of the brake actuators.
The system shall perform an avoidance maneuver (i.e., a lane change) to avoid collisions with obstacles, if safe.
The system shall detect road boundaries and the shape of each lane.
The system shall detect other vehicles or obstacles on adjacent lane.
The system shall start switch road lanes within 100 ms (tbc) after an obstacle is detected within a dangerous zone (tbd).
The system shall ensure that steering commands are provided within 50 ms (tbc).
The system shall identify sensor failures.
The system shall use more than one sensor used to identify obstacles.
The system shall identify when the lidar sensor has failed.
The system shall identify when the camera has failed.
The system shall mitigate sensor failures.
The system shall detect objects by using a combination of different sensors.
The system shall use only information from working sensors.
The system shall inform the driver about sensor failures.
